text: Pause here, at the threshold. Behind you lies everything you have known, the third density,
the world of choice, it is a world wrapped in forgetting, a veil drawn between what you are
and what you know, so that nothing is given and everything must be chosen. In the dark behind
that veil, every soul faces the same question, lifetime after lifetime. Will you serve others
or will you serve only yourself? There is no answer the universe will punish you for.
There is only the direction you walk, step by step, until the walking itself has made you into
someone. Some walk this road for tens of thousands of years. The veil holds because the choice
must be real. A test you can see coming is no test at all. Every kindness done in the dark,
every cruelty was weighed without witness and that is what made it yours. And now, for you,
the choosing is nearly done. What lies beyond this door is what the choice was for. Breathe.
When you're ready, step through and leave the forgetting behind.
